summary: All six phases delivered their stated objectives. Phase 01 touched ~36 unplanned test files due to an atomic schema value-type change that broke every string-array profile fixture — anticipated in the plan's own seam note and justified. Phase 05 left the planned `src/app/recordsExplain.ts` unedited (the field became available through the schema change alone) and instead edited the unplanned `src/cli/commands/records.ts` (the only layer that renders structured data as user-visible text). Phase 06 edited three unplanned files (`src/cli/cliDocs.ts`, `phax.usage.kdl`, `src/cli/commands/records.ts`) because `phax.usage.kdl` and `docs/cli/reference.md` are generated artifacts; their source strings had to change first. All deviations are justified; no phase introduced unjustified scope creep or dropped a required deliverable. One attention point: the plan-required `pickGateProfileId` test was not found in `tests/unit/gateProfile.test.ts` and may reside in `tests/unit/cli/run.test.ts` — human verification recommended before closing.

findings.message: All schema symbols (GateStepSchema, SurfaceSchema, FiringSchema, GateStep, Surface, Firing), resolver and runner signature changes, depth-scalar removal, generator updates, fixture migrations, and JSON schema regeneration are present as specified.

~36 unplanned test files were edited. Justified: the atomic GateProfilesSchema value-type change broke every fixture that built a profile as a string array or decoded through decodePhaxConfig. The plan's seam note explicitly anticipated this ('update every fixture/assertion … string array') and acknowledged the enumerated list was a subset.

The plan-required pickGateProfileId test (asserting fast/full preference is gone, first key selected) was not found in tests/unit/gateProfile.test.ts. It may reside in tests/unit/cli/run.test.ts (a planned edit, matched per reconciliation). Human verification needed.
Flat-array rejection test (naming the profile), unknown-surface rejection, unknown-firing rejection, and onExcessProperty tests are all present in tests/unit/gateProfile.test.ts.
gateCommandStrings = gateSteps.map(s => s.command) feeds security preflight/posture and prompt; typed gateSteps feeds the gate runner. Frozen effective set includes all steps regardless of firing.
Commit subject feat(gate): model gate profiles as attributed steps matches plan.

Covers all required content: exported symbols and module paths, resolveGateProfile return type, runGates signature, command-string derivation location, depth-preference removal confirmation, full/standard key decision, and unplanned-file deviation explanation.
selectGateSteps pure helper created; executePlan phase loop filters steps by firing using isFinal; security preflight remains over the full command set.
No deviations. Exactly the planned create/edit files were touched; no optional files needed edits.

tests/unit/selectGateSteps.test.ts has four unit tests (non-terminal, terminal, all-every-phase, all-terminal). executePlan.test.ts has the firing scheduling integration test (non-terminal omits terminal step; terminal phase includes both).
Preflight uses unfiltered full set; only the per-phase gate invocation is filtered by firing. Surface remains pure attribution.
Commit subject feat(gate): schedule steps by firing (every-phase vs terminal) matches plan.
Covers selectGateSteps signature, security preflight confirmation, no deviations, and the key invariant for phase-03.

GateAttributionSchema and GateStepResultSchema in src/schemas/gateAttribution.ts. runGates refactored to RunGatesOptions object with optional attributionPath/phaseId; writes gate-attribution.json on both success and failure paths. fixLoop.ts passes attributionPath and phaseId. adaptGateRun writes no attribution (no phase folder available).
No deviations. Optional files tests/integration/eventAdapter.test.ts and src/app/executePlan.ts correctly left untouched.

tests/unit/gateAttribution.test.ts has schema round-trip, surface-enum rejection, and missing-field tests. Integration tests cover runGates attribution accumulation, fail-fast recording, and fix-loop overwrite semantics.

gate-attribution.json at <runPath>/<phaseId>/gate-attribution.json, shape { phase, steps: [{ command, surface, result }] }, written via FileSystem port. adaptGateRun omits attribution target — documented in handoff.
Commit subject feat(gate): record per-phase gate attribution matches plan.
Covers exact file path and record shape, RunGatesOptions signature, both callers' behavior, and the adaptGateRun rationale. Phase-04/05 consumers are fully briefed.

verifiedSurfaces pure domain helper in src/domain/gate/verifiedSurfaces.ts (all-pass-per-surface, sorted, deduped). aggregateVerifiedSurfaces Effect reader in src/app/gateAttribution.ts (missing files silently skipped). writeFinalReport computes and renders - **Surfaces Verified**: list or (none).
No deviations. Optional files src/app/executePlan.ts and src/app/reviewCode.ts correctly left untouched.

tests/unit/verifiedSurfaces.test.ts has five unit tests. tests/unit/gateAttribution.reader.test.ts covers the reader with FileSystem fake. tests/integration/finalReport.test.ts (new file) tests both the surfaces-present and empty-state paths.
buildFinalReportMarkdown stays a pure synchronous renderer; Effect-based read confined to writeFinalReport. Reader uses FileSystem port, not raw node:fs.
Commit subject feat(gate): report verified surfaces at run end matches plan.
Covers pure helper path and signature, reader signature, exact render format (including empty state), and the phase-05 reuse directive.

RunRecordManifestSchema bumped to version 2 with required verifiedSurfaces field. assembleRecord copies verbatim. writeRecord reads gate-attribution.json via FileSystem port and falls back to [] on any failure. Records list and explain render the field.
src/app/recordsExplain.ts (planned to edit) was not touched: ExplainedRecord already embeds the full RunRecordManifest, so no new code was needed once the schema gained the field. Justified.

src/cli/commands/records.ts (unplanned) was edited: it is the only layer where structured data from recordsList/recordsExplain reaches the user as text. Without this edit the field would be computed but invisible. Justified.

tests/unit/runRecord.test.ts has v2 decode, v1 rejection, surfaces array, and surface-enum rejection tests. tests/unit/recordsAssemble.test.ts covers verbatim copy. tests/integration/writeRecord.test.ts has three attribution tests (passing, missing, corrupt). tests/integration/recordsExplain.test.ts matched per reconciliation.
Same verifiedSurfaces helper as phase-04 — one definition of verified. writeRecord reads from FileSystem port. Per-phase only; no run-level aggregation in records.
Git log confirms feat(records): name verified surfaces in the phase record manifest. Matches plan.
Covers schema shape, fallback behavior, sample output lines for both records list and records explain, and the deviation justification.

No code behavior changed.
No code or schema changes. Archived plans/specs untouched. CLAUDE.md correctly left unedited (no gate-profile or fast/full references).

Three unplanned files edited: src/cli/cliDocs.ts, phax.usage.kdl, and src/cli/commands/records.ts.
